notes:
Summary: Mid-market product company (consumer shopping vertical) evaluating Redwood first via Hosted API trial -> demo -> POC with intention to convert to Dedicated if cost and isolation make sense. Primary focus: reranking endpoint to improve search relevance and surface more commercial results.

Context & requirements:
- Workload: query-time reranking of top-50 candidates from their retrieval layer; also offline batch scoring to produce training labels and business metrics.
- Targets: 95th %-ile latency budget 120-150ms for rerank calls; typical QPS on peak promotions 150-250 rps; steady-state 40-80 rps.
- Cost sensitivity: mid; willing to trade some latency for significant cost savings. CFO wants clear unit economics before signing Dedicated.
- Model prefs: prefer open-ish model family (Llama2 variants) but open to Redwood-curated quantized models if accuracy holds. Need ability to A/B between model variants and fall back to cheaper variant on load.
- Evaluation: will run Redwood rerank endpoint on curated eval sets (10k queries v1 -> aim to expand to 50k), want offline scoring (batch) and automated eval metrics (ndcg@10, recall@50, business-weighted CTR lift).
- Security: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML, audit logs, US data residency; VPC for Dedicated preferred for isolation. KMS integration required for Dedicated.

Timeline & progress (CRM-style):
- 2026-01-20: Intro demo (hosted API) — showed streaming gen & embeddings + basic rerank demo. VP Product quote: "need deterministic cost model + predictable tail latency for campaigns".
- 2026-02-01: AE follow-up, provided pricing sheet for Hosted vs Dedicated (v1).
- 2026-02-15: POC kickoff meeting (fireflies ff_2026-02-15_8203). Scope: ingest eval-set v1, run offline scoring job, run rerank A/B against live traffic for 2 weeks (canary).
- 2026-02-28: Mid-POC check-in; early offline scoring results look promising, but requests for larger eval set and additional business-weighted metrics (fireflies ff_2026-02-28_9142).
- 2026-03-02: Pricing discussion with finance on Dedicated recommendation (drive:/pricing/redwood-dedicated-proposal-v2.pdf).

POC artifacts/stubs: drive:/POCs/rankflow/2026-02-poc-plan.pdf, drive:/shared/rankflow/eval-set-v1.csv. Jira tickets RDW-1124 (POC infra config), RDW-1201 (security questionnaire start).

Open items / Next steps:
- AE to provide detailed unit economics for Dedicated (per-traffic tier) and formal escalation path for capacity spikes.
- Product/SE to expand eval-set to 50k queries; SE Diego to provide ingestion script and offline batch job template.
- Security team to complete SOC2 questionnaire; legal to review Dedicated contract.
- Plan can move to procurement if CFO OKs estimated ARR.
